_comment: Measured outcomes against PROTOCOL.md. Nothing here redefines the design; it only records what was observed. Off-ledger exploration goes in FINDINGS.md, never here.

M1.note: Town01 (A3). Lit/unlit resolved (A4): site 1 unlit at 4.5, site 3 lit at 25.7 mean brightness, night lamps off

M2.note: a_max 0.868 g, t_lat 0.150 s over 10 reps/speed; contact detector -1.23 ft on a deliberate crash; oracle 10/10 perfect and 0/10 late

M3.note: expert 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, outcomes identical across lighting; scenario objects built and both oracle checks pass

M4.note: both policies 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, braking at 33.6 ft against r_req 34.7, standoff 5.4-5.5 ft

M5.note: both gates pass behaviourally for BOTH policies: capture 0.191 (P_cont) / 0.260 (P_pts); in-between worst 0.454 (P_cont) / 0.578 (P_pts) over covered sub-intervals, failing only inside the A6-excluded sliver (FINDINGS F2)

M6.note: lead: both properties, both policies, committed before driving (S 6/11, 8/11). ped: S committed before driving -- P_pts 5/15, P_cont 14/15 covered; A: P_cont 3/15, P_pts queued on GPU availability

M7.note: P_pts 10/11 agreement, P_cont 9/11, every disagreement conservative. P_pts drove 0/10 at three dusk illuminations where P_cont drove 10/10, 10/10, 5/10

M8.note: figure and full report done (docs/STUDY_REPORT.md, docs/figures/dusk_gap.html); paper not drafted

1.width_note: contiguous falsified band +25.899 to +0.360 deg over the covered sub-intervals; the uncoverable [0.36, 0.00] sliver is excluded from the width as it is from the coverage claim (F2/F3)
1.note: FALSIFIED across 25.5 deg of dusk between the endpoints; certified only at the extremes. Witness drives pending CARLA handback.

2.note: FALSIFIED, drove 0/10 at three dusk illuminations
2.width_note: total width of the falsified sub-intervals, degrees of sun altitude (axis 60 to -30)

3.note: certified in ALL 14 covered sub-intervals; the only falsification is the declared-uncovered horizon sliver. Witness drives pending CARLA handback.

4.note: CERTIFIED in the shoulder, drove 10/10 where P_pts drove 0/10

capture_check.note: BEHAVIOURAL: policy output placed vs driven, 20 poses around r_req, worst 0.812 m/s2 = 0.191 of the brake decision threshold

in_between_check.note: BEHAVIOURAL: policy output on a blend vs a render at the same illumination, worst 0.454 of the decision threshold, in the two sub-intervals adjacent to the horizon. Everywhere else 0.02-0.17, as A5 predicted from image space.
